meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 当你提出一个问题、决策或创意挑战时，Claude会召唤一个由4-6个不同思维原型组成的“心智委员会”，每个成员从自身角度阐述立场、推理和洞见，然后合成出收敛点、核心张力、盲点以及推荐路径。
howto.when: 当你需要多元视角、面临艰难抉择、要求委员会讨论，或提到“委员会模式”“心智委员会”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我开一个心智委员会，讨论是否应该辞职创业。
say.note: 委员会将召唤多个思维原型进行辩论和合成。

say.text: 用委员会模式分析这个商业决策的利弊。
say.note: Claude会自动选择合适的成员并执行三阶段审议。

say.text: 我需要多角度审视这个创意项目，启动深度委员会。
say.note: 你会看到6位成员的长篇分析及合成报告。

howto.what_en: Runs a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Summons 4-6 diverse thinking archetypes, each giving their stance, reasoning, key risk, and surprising insight, then synthesizes convergence, core tension, blind spot, and recommended path.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user needs diverse viewpoints, faces a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, or mentions keywords like 'council mode' or 'mind council'.

say_en.text: Run a mind council on whether I should quit my job and start a company.
say_en.note: The council will deliberate in three phases.

say_en.text: Use council mode to analyze this business decision.
say_en.note: Appropriate members selected and phased deliberation executed.

say_en.text: I need multiple perspectives on this creative project, start a deep council.
say_en.note: You will see 6 members' extended reasoning and synthesis.
